- **The local plan (`plan/`)**: `/afk:execute` owns only the PLAN.md progress-tracker `Status` cell of the subtask it runs (+ `Last updated` date). **`/afk:smoke-test`** owns a disjoint slice of the same PLAN.md — the `## Feature smoke gate` table's `Status` cells, its `Last run` line, its append-only `Run history` lines, and the header `Feature:` line — nothing else. **`plan/JOURNAL.md`** is append-only multi-writer (`/afk:execute`, `/afk:autopilot`, `/afk:smoke-test`, `/afk:preflight`, `/afk:understand` append; nobody edits/deletes a prior line; format owned by `skills/afk/to-subtasks/JOURNAL-FORMAT.md`). **`plan/DECISIONS.md`** (the decision ledger) is append-only under the same rule — classification + grammar owned by root `DECISIONS.md`; writers append via that protocol, readers: every executor before working a slice, the orchestrator's end-of-run report. **`plan/review/`** (reports + `INDEX.md` + `PATTERN-DEBT.md`) owned by `/afk:review`, with two disjoint co-writers under their own naming: `/afk:adversary`'s report files, and the review gate's callers' `*.outcomes.json` remediation records. **`plan/TRACE.md`** written once by the terminal sync-harness subtask. **Lifespan**: `plan/` is a run artifact — lives from slicing to merge; after the MR merges, `/afk:gc` (human-approved) deletes it whole, git history the archive — the one sanctioned post-ship deletion.
